question: Should `/workspace` become a supported path contract in gateway and CLI runtime containers, or remain reserved for sandbox-container workspaces?
rationale: Source and release evidence establish the mismatch, but repository policy discourages aliases without a deliberate contract; either direction affects Docker, Podman, sandbox terminology, documentation, and future compatibility expectations.

options.title: Keep sandbox-only
options.body: Retain `/home/node/.openclaw/workspace` as the sole runtime-container path and fix any specific prompt or documentation that incorrectly implies otherwise.

options.title: Adopt runtime alias
options.body: Add `/workspace` as an explicitly supported alias across Docker and Podman runtime containers with ownership, mount-conflict, and smoke coverage.

recommendation.title: Keep sandbox-only
recommendation.body: Retain `/home/node/.openclaw/workspace` as the sole runtime-container path and fix any specific prompt or documentation that incorrectly implies otherwise.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this owner most directly to Compose paths, Docker setup entrypoints, and container documentation.
